purpose: Level 2 STRUCTURAL: the homepage's own <a href> links exposed only /cart, /contact, /radio, /services-2 (no events/programme link), so the publicly-exposed Squarespace sitemap.xml was fetched to enumerate the site's real page inventory.
method: curl -sS -L -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; BandOnTheMapResearch/1.0; +research)' --max-time 15 (single unauthenticated GET; no retries)
extraction_note: <loc> URLs extracted from the retained sitemap.xml body via a plain regex/tag-strip over the real response; image sitemap entries omitted for boundedness.
notable_finding: No /events, /whats-on, /gigs, /calendar, /listings, or /programme page is listed anywhere in the site's own public sitemap. The only event-shaped page is /jazz-lunchtim, investigated separately (see jazz-lunchtime-page.json).
